verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear hierarchy (big headline, body, then CTA with legal beside it) and the book sits on the confetti, but the Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk to near-illegibility, the card runs flush to the right and bottom edges, and the legal text next to the CTA is tiny. B is broken: the CTA is jammed into the bottom-left corner, running off the card edge, and it covers the legal line, which is cut off mid-sentence. Its widely tracked eyebrow nearly competes with the headline, and the book and logo float loosely in the top band.
